note: Coverage counts rows that carry a real opening AND closing number. A row exists for every originated market so that adding a licensed feed fills the table rather than changing its shape.

schema_fields.open_line: the opening number, from a licensed source; blank until one is registered
schema_fields.open_price: the opening price in American odds; blank for the same reason
schema_fields.line_move: close_line - open_line; computable only when both exist
schema_fields.clv_points: closing value in points for the originated side; blank without a close

empty_because: NFL.com publishes no price for any fixture (verified on the Week 10 schedule page, 2026-11-14); no sportsbook is a registered source in this repository; and NFL.com Terms §1.3 prohibits systematic compilation. The market therefore has no executable number.
